title: VERITAS: A Unified Approach to Reliability Evaluation

live_model.evidence: Sec 6: "In the generative models category, we selected GPT-4 Turbo as the closed-source baseline due to its competitive performance across various LLM-as-judge benchmarks."; Table 3 row "GPT4 Turbo 76.1 86.8 73.9 85.6 76.0 69.2 77.9".

prompt.location: Appendix A/B only cover input formatting and instruction templates for the authors' own fine-tuned classifier/generative models (DeBERTa, LLaMA); no prompt or template is given anywhere for the GPT-4 Turbo baseline itself

claim.metric: LLM-as-judge classification score, VERITAS Bench (NLI/QA/Dialog average)
claim.location: Table 3, row GPT4 Turbo, Average column (built from LLM AggreFact, PubMedQA, FinanceBench, HaluEvalQA, HalluDial, HaluEval Dialog)

data.source: Ten public datasets underlying VERITAS Bench (LLM AggreFact, PubMedQA, FinanceBench, HaluEvalQA, HalluDial, HaluEval Dialog, etc.); Table 5 additionally uses two proprietary enterprise datasets, not used for this claim

notes: Role (baseline, B) and the numeric claim are otherwise clean, but no prompt or instruction template for querying GPT-4 Turbo as a judge appears anywhere in the paper (Appendices A-B only cover the authors' own fine-tuned models), so the claim cannot be re-executed at prompt level. Table 5 (enterprise data) is closed and would add a data_closed blocker if used instead.
